rachel: Short thread: migration playbook for moving from redwood.quant.v1 header to a richer quant_manifest for mixed FP8/INT8/4bit support. want a checklist we can hand to infra + devex.

tom: high level goals? minimize customer disruption, avoid silent regressions, allow a compatibility shim.

rachel: exactly. propose three compatibility layers: 1) packager emits quant_manifest (json + optional cbor blob) alongside existing header; 2) runtime ships an ABI adapter shim that converts manifest -> legacy header for older kernels; 3) nodes advertise "manifest_capable" when they can use mixed kernels natively.

jiayi: for the shim: do we translate fallback_order and per-shard layout into the old flags? risk of losing fidelity. shim should be conservative: only translate when manifest maps cleanly to legacy semantics, else cause a lint/block at deploy time.

marco: agree. add a deploy-time validator that refuses to publish a model if manifest references kernels not present in kernel-registry and no safe legacy mapping exists. validator should produce actionable messages.

rachel: rollout steps I propose: A) land packager changes that write manifest alongside header; B) run lint for a week to collect mismatches (dry-run mode, warn only); C) deploy adapter shim to canary nodes; D) enable routing for opt-in endpoints; E) enable full enforcement.

tom: what's in the validator's output? need it to include: missing_kernels, incompatible_layout_shards, estimated_quality_impact (from calibration table), suggested fallback.

jiayi: calibration table idea: keep a compact per-model mapping of fallback->expected_quality_drop. validator uses it to compute worst-case. for unknowns, default to conservative high-drop.

marco: tests: add three suites: unit lint tests, smoke perf on canary nodes, fidelity delta on curated prompts. also add a fuzz harness that randomly permutes per-shard bitmaps to check the validator.

rachel: telemetry we must emit: quant.manifest_id, quant.manifest_version, quant.adapted_to_legacy (bool), quant.fallback_taken, quant.quality_delta_estimate. infra-bot: please create dashboards for fallback_rate and quality_delta by customer.

infra-bot: Dashboard request queued: fallback_rate_by_customer, quality_delta_estimate, manifest_lint_failures.

jiayi: customer opt-in UX: add a flag in create-deployment: use_quant_manifest: enum[auto, opt-in, enforce]. auto means shim+adapter; opt-in means route only to manifest-capable nodes; enforce means reject requests when manifest can't be honored. default auto. SDK surfaces warning and shows expected quality delta.

tom: billing implications: if a customer opts into aggressive fallbacks we should show estimated cost savings and require explicit acceptance during deploy. devex must add a preview in the console.

marco: emergency rollback plan: if canary shows quality regressions, we revert routing predicate and mark manifest as disabled in package registry. add an alert if fallback_rate spike > threshold.

rachel: security/compliance note: manifests must be checksummed and signed by packager; nodes must verify signature before accepting. include manifest_checksum in deployment metadata.

jiayi: implementation owners: rachel -> packager + manifest schema; tom -> runtime shim + routing rules; marco -> validator + lint pipeline; infra-bot -> dashboards. aim for dry-run lint in two weeks, shim canary in three.

rachel: i'll draft the playbook with commands, example manifest, and lint error examples. will post link when ready. thanks! :white_check_mark:
